rules.text: นิยายแต่ง: โรงเรียนมีอยู่จริง แต่เหตุการณ์ซอมบี้ทั้งหมดไม่ใช่เรื่องจริง
Scene voiceover has exactly one assigned Thai voice profile. Audio files are not embedded; generate TTS and verify exact audio durations before export.
Do not replace event props with generic buildings; retain props placement and keyframes and do not generate gore.
Authored door motion per scene is in productionMotionOverrides: closing in scene 5, locked in scenes 6/9 and opening in scenes 10/12. No accidental opening during a locked-door beat.
